Zoe: Quick follow-up from the LB/DNS postmortem. Collecting owners & ETAs for remediation items related to retry storms and cross-region TLS failures. Reply with ack + ETA.

Tom: Ack. I'll take the routing config changes to reduce cross-region retries and add sticky decay. ETA: PR by Mon.

Hannah: I'll run the canary and smoke tests once Tom's PR is out. ETA: tests complete Wed morning.

IncidentBot: Incident 2025-11-12 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/lb-dns-retry-loop-2025 (auto)

Ethan: Observed recurring DNS TTL drift causing transient routing to stale endpoints. I'll add telemetry and a dashboard tile. ETA: Thu.

Rita: I'll draft the on-call runbook snippet and alert playbook for TLS/SNI spikes. ETA: Fri.

Tom: Draft config snippet pushed:
```yaml
failover:
  cross_region_retries: 1
  backoff_ms: 250
  sticky_decay_s: 600
```
Link: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2477

Hannah: Canary started at 04:00 PT with 5% to region-d. Early signals: retry_count down 35%, small SNI mismatch bump 0.12%. Will monitor 3h.

Zoe: Recap of action items:
- Tom: routing PR (ETA Mon)
- Hannah: canary + smoke (ETA Wed)
- Ethan: telemetry & dashboard (ETA Thu)
- Rita: playbook & alert text (ETA Fri)

Ethan: Datadog query I'll add:
```
sum:network.tls.sni_mismatch{env:prod}.by{region}.rollup(sum,60)
```
Alert: ratio > 0.003 for 5m.

Hannah: Canary completed 3.5h, no customer-facing errors. Proceeding to 25% ramp.

Tom: PR merged with healthcheck tweak to prefer SNI validation: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/+/2483. Rolling now.

Rita: Playbook created, alert ID DD-4921. Added steps for quick rollback and customer-notice template.

Zoe: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the postmortem remediation tracker and close items when we have final alert IDs and can confirm customer outreach.
